email.subject1: a signal play for Gorilla Logic
email.body1:
Jay, saw Gorilla Logic expanded nearshoring into Mexico and added a Chief Growth Officer and CMO to push the growth plan.

An expansion and leadership build like that usually opens more accounts than the team can cover before reps reach them all, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Gorilla Logic off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jay, quick follow-up for Gorilla Logic.

With the Mexico expansion and a new growth team, targets for automotive and manufacturing usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jay, last bit of proof for Gorilla Logic.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your team's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jay, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a Mexico expansion plus new leadership keeps a team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your automotive and manufacturing motion? I will tailor it to Gorilla Logic either way.
